mapper.select: select ch.*, ch.longitude_wgs84 as longitude, ch.latitude_wgs84 as latitude, '0' as channelType, cat.id as parentId from video_device_channel ch join video_platform_gb_channel rel on rel.device_channel_id = ch.channel_id and rel.del_flag = '0' join video_platform_catalog cat on cat.id = rel.catalog_id and cat.platform_id = rel.platform_id and cat.del_flag = '0' where ch.del_flag = '0' and rel.platform_id = #{serverGbId}
